entities.summary: Sergey Vladilenovich Kiriyenko is a Russian politician who has served as First Deputy Chief of Staff of the Presidential Administration of Russia since 5 October 2016. He previously served as the 30th Prime Minister of Russia from 23 March to 23 August 1998 under President Boris Yeltsin, and was head of the Rosatom nuclear energy company between 2005 and 2016. Kiriyenko was the youngest Prime Minister of Russia, taking the position at age 35. Ideologically a technocrat, he has played a leading role in the governance of Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine since the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the youngest Prime Minister of Russia at age 35, Kiriyenko played a key role in shaping Russian politics during the Yeltsin era. His tenure from 1998 to 1998 had significant regional implications for post-Soviet Russia.
